flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged (automatic, singleton trigger). PRECONDITION: a Rep must have been chosen (self.getWhileInPlayData() rep != null, else the trigger method returns null and the card can never flip).
flipToBack.prose: If any non-Tatooine location is on table: flip requires you OCCUPY >= 3 battleground sites AND at least one battleground site is occupied with a non-unique alien of your Rep's species. If NO non-Tatooine location is on table: flip requires you OCCUPY >= 2 battleground sites. Occupy, not control.

children.req: state guard: Rep was chosen at setup
children.gameConditions: rep == null -> return null (no flip trigger exists without a Rep)

children.req: table-state: at least one non-Tatooine location on table
occupy-with: owner occupies >= 1 battleground site with a non-unique alien of Rep's species
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.occupiesWith(game, self, playerId, Filters.battleground_site, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Filters.alien, Filters.species(rep.getBlueprint().getSpecies())))

children.req: table-state: any non-Tatooine location on table

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged (automatic, singleton trigger). No Rep guard on this trigger.
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you do NOT occupy at least 2 battleground sites.

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: OCCUPY semantics throughout (GameConditions.occupies / occupiesWith), NOT control. Presence at battleground sites is enough; opponent co-presence does not matter.

The 3-site branch adds an occupy-WITH requirement: at least one occupied battleground site must contain a non-unique alien matching the Rep's species (species is read dynamically from the chosen Rep's blueprint, Filters.species(rep.getBlueprint().getSpecies())).
Branch selector is a table-state check: GameConditions.canSpotLocation(game, Filters.non_Tatooine_location). Any non-Tatooine location on table (either player's) forces the harder 3-site branch.
Rep is chosen-state stored in WhileInPlayData at setup; without it the front cannot flip (trigger returns null).
flipToFront: negated occupy-count (hold 2 battleground sites or flip back).
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Filters.alien, Filters.species(rep.getBlueprint().getSpecies())) (dynamic species filter from chosen Rep)
Filters.and(Filters.unique, Filters.alien, Filters.hasSpecies) (Rep selection filter at setup)
Filters.Trap_Door + Filters.Rancor at Filters.Rancor_Pit (Bo Shuda immunity condition)

No hard-lose / place-out-of-play condition on either side.
seedMismatches: Seed does not record the Rep-null guard: on the front, if no Rep was chosen (WhileInPlayData empty) the flip trigger method returns null and the objective can NEVER flip (Card112_001.java:134-137). Behavioral fact missing from seed.

Seed structure nests the 2-site and 3-site branches as 'alternatives' of one requirement without stating the branch selector's exclusivity: source is a strict if/else-if on canSpotLocation(non_Tatooine_location); the 2-battleground branch is ONLY evaluated when no non-Tatooine location exists on table.

profileGaps: flipGateSite is null: gate is generic battleground sites (occupy 2 or 3); nothing marks battleground_site as the flip target even though objectiveNamedLocations lists it.
keyCharacterFilter is null: the Rep and the non-unique alien of Rep's species (dynamic species filter) are the flip law's key actors; no representation.
Occupy-vs-control distinction and the counts (2 vs 3) are not encoded anywhere.
The non-Tatooine-location branch selector (harder requirement once any non-Tatooine location hits the table) has no representation.
requiredCardsOnTable empty: Rep chosen-state (mandatory for the flip to exist) is not represented.
